title: english and mathematics teachers’ integration of 21st century skills into their instruction: reality and barriers in the saudi context
core_idea: To examine the extent to which English and mathematics teachers integrate four key 21st century skills (creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, communication) into their instruction in the Saudi context and to identify major barriers preventing such integration, using a sequential exploratory mixed-methods design (observations, interviews, and a questionnaire).
tldr: Investigate how English and math teachers in Saudi Arabia incorporate four 21st century skills and what obstacles hinder that integration, using observations, interviews, and a survey.
